result:
This matches upstream PR #3504 exactly (14 insertions, 65 deletions there vs. our 14/70 — the small difference is git's line-ending diff bookkeeping, not content).

Summary of the fix:
- **`src/click/shell_completion.py`**: Reverted the broken 8.4.0 newline-based fish record format. `FishComplete.format_completion` now returns `type,value` (or `type,value\tescaped_help` when help text exists), escaping embedded `\n` in help as literal `\n` and collapsing tabs to spaces. The `_SOURCE_FISH` script now splits each response line on `","` again instead of on a literal (and unquoted, syntactically broken) `\n`, and just echoes `value\thelp` directly — matching fish's documented `complete` format where each line is `value<TAB>description`.
- **`tests/test_shell_completion.py`**: Updated expected fish completion output to the new `plain,a` / `plain,b\tbee` format, and removed the now-obsolete `test_fish_multiline_help_complete` test tied to the old three-line format.

Full test suite: 1562 passed, 93 skipped, 1 xfailed — no failures.
